## Camera Back Image Studio

Open Images to generate or import a picture and see it on the camera screen. Use Edit image for a whole-image variation or a selected-area edit. The filmstrip shows your saved renders and lets you return to a picture or reuse its prompt and settings.

- History thumbnails load as you scroll. Each thumbnail is made from the verified PNG and measures at most 160 pixels on its longest side.
- Rapidly switching back to the previous image now shows the correct picture. Moving between pages of history also selects a frame on the current page.
- The console and camera adapt to shorter or narrower windows. Image details and project attachment controls sit below the filmstrip.

Windows testing exercised the native file picker, a real local GPU render, and a selected-area edit that changed 64,011 pixels and preserved the original PNG. The final packaged page reopened all three verified images. The layout was checked at 1552 × 1013, 1280 × 720 and 960 × 680. Eleven native image tests, fourteen renderer bridge tests and the browser history regression passed. This was a focused Image Studio verification.

Source commit 27e1c50569818f7798f82d24591673bc91647858.
